bbs_lip_sync.ui.pick_language.title: Which language does the character speak?
bbs_lip_sync.ui.text.title: Lip sync from text
bbs_lip_sync.ui.text.placeholder: The character's line. A comma is a short pause, a full stop or a new line closes the mouth.
bbs_lip_sync.ui.text.speed_tooltip: 1 is an ordinary pace, 2 twice as fast. Pauses stay the same.
bbs_lip_sync.ui.pick_audio.title: Which audio clip is spoken?
bbs_lip_sync.ui.no_audio.title: No audio
bbs_lip_sync.ui.no_audio.message: Add an audio clip to the camera timeline first: lip sync needs sound to listen to.
bbs_lip_sync.ui.no_poses.title: No mouth poses
bbs_lip_sync.ui.no_poses.message: The poses.json of model "%s" has no mouth poses. Lip sync looks for poses named idle, a, o, u, ee, b, d, f and l, like the bundled player/mouth rig.
bbs_lip_sync.ui.error.title: Lip sync failed
bbs_lip_sync.ui.error.audio_unreadable: Couldn't read %s. Supported formats are wav and ogg; video files need ffmpeg to be set up in BBS.
bbs_lip_sync.ui.error.native: The speech recognition library (Vosk) couldn't be loaded on this system. It runs on Windows x64, Linux x64 and macOS.
bbs_lip_sync.ui.error.model_corrupt: The model "%s" couldn't be loaded: its files are damaged or incomplete. Delete the model's folder and download it again.
bbs_lip_sync.ui.error.letters: Couldn't read the letter table "%s". Check the file in config/bbs/lipsync/letters.
bbs_lip_sync.ui.model.title: Speech recognition model
bbs_lip_sync.ui.model.downloading_hint: You can hide this window, lip sync will start on its own.
bbs_lip_sync.ui.model.error_network: Couldn't download. Check your internet connection.
bbs_lip_sync.ui.model.error_corrupt: The archive didn't unpack. Try again.
bbs_lip_sync.ui.model.error_disk: Couldn't write to disk. Free some space.
bbs_lip_sync.ui.model.error_hint: Or download the archive from the link and unpack it into the models folder.
bbs_lip_sync.config.title: Lip Sync
bbs_lip_sync.config.speech.title: Speech
bbs_lip_sync.config.speech.tooltip: Which language and model listen to the audio
bbs_lip_sync.config.speech.language-comm: The language spoken in the audio. By default it follows Minecraft's; right click brings that back. The same list opens from the track's menu: "Speech language".
bbs_lip_sync.config.speech.model_size-co: Small (30–140 MB) is fast and good enough for lip sync. Large (up to 2 GB) hears words more accurately but loads slowly and takes a lot of memory; not every language has one.
bbs_lip_sync.config.speech.unload_model-: Frees memory (from 100 MB for a small model to 2–3 GB for a large one). The next generation starts a little later.
bbs_lip_sync.config.timing.title: Timing
bbs_lip_sync.config.timing.tooltip: How generated mouth keyframes are placed in time
bbs_lip_sync.config.timing.anticipation-: The mouth starts moving this many ticks before the sound, the way people do. Without it lip sync looks late.
bbs_lip_sync.config.timing.min_hold-comm: Consonant shapes (d, l) shorter than this dissolve into the neighbouring vowel so the mouth doesn't flicker. Lip closures (b, f) are always shown.
bbs_lip_sync.config.timing.min_pause-com: The mouth closes only when the pause between words lasts at least this long. Shorter gaps hold the last shape, so the mouth doesn't snap shut for a single tick.
bbs_lip_sync.config.timing.close_delay-c: How many ticks the mouth keeps its last shape after a word ends before it closes. At 0 it closes right when the sound stops.
